t: Jeyes classic fluid is a powerful 5Ltr outdoor disinfectant and cleaner, specifically formulated to eliminate 99.9% of bacteria and tackle stubborn dirt, grime, and stains. Ideal for professional outdoor environments, such as cleaning patios, pathways, and driveways, or disinfecting commercial greenhouses and agricultural equipment. This concentrated fluid effectively removes unsightly algae, mould, and deep-set stains from paving, garden tools, and water butts, ensuring a clean and protected workspace. Trusted by trade professionals, its proven formulation is also DEFRA approved against avian influenza.
